summary: Completed Module 01-02 Interlude reflection on the Therac-25 incident, connecting falsifiable hypotheses, hidden safety nets, and user-first observability to production incident response.
evidence: Reflected on falsifiable hypotheses: Analyzed why confirmation-bias tests ('testing only what we expect') fail to detect catastrophic bugs; defined disconfirming tests targeting edge cases, rapid race sequences, and boundary violations.

Reflected on telemetry vs human feedback: Analyzed why green dashboards and error-free logs can deceive engineers when telemetry doesn't instrument real failure modes; established that user symptoms must be treated as primary diagnostic evidence.

Connected lessons to production systems: Examined how defense-in-depth safety nets (hardware interlocks, circuit breakers) can silently mask latent software bugs until removed or pushed beyond capacity.
